inventory.sourceFigureDescription: The CLaSH rule (Carcinomas-Lymphatics, Sarcomas-Hematogenous — the source's own acronym), the four carcinomas that route hematogenously (follicular thyroid, choriocarcinoma, renal cell, hepatocellular), the metastasis-vs-primary rule (more common than 1° in bone/liver/lung/brain; multiple vs solitary lesions), and the 4-row site-of-metastasis table (Bone, Liver, Lung, Brain) with their tumor lists and notes (including the bone blastic/mixed/lytic fork). Pure text.
inventory.kypLocation: the registry visual (the CLaSH panel + the 4-row site grid + the bone fork) + blocks[1] the table block carried verbatim

notes: The page's text blocks (the CLaSH rule, the 4-hematogenous-carcinoma exception list, the metastasis-vs-primary rule, and the 4-row site-of-metastasis table with the bone blastic/mixed/lytic fork) are adapted as the registry visual and carried verbatim in the note's table block.
